title: Devfactory Provider Config
description: Schema for Provider.Config when Provider.Type is "devfactory". Devfactory is a reference/simulation provider — no real infrastructure required — used for end-to-end testing and as a template for provider authors.

data_dir.description: Directory where devfactory.json is stored. If empty, a temporary directory is created automatically.

profile.description: What kind of resource this provider simulates. Default: "container".

latency.description: Simulated provisioning delay before a resource transitions from creating to running. Zero/omitted uses the profile default. Accepts a human-readable duration string (e.g. "800ms", "1.5s") or a number of nanoseconds.

fail_create.description: If true, Create returns an error. Useful for testing error handling paths.

fail_update.description: If true, Update returns an error.

fail_delete.description: If true, Delete returns an error.

labels.description: Labels passed through to resource metadata.
